traces.name: collection grid: Qty edit, Tab order, focus after an edit
steps: tap the Qty cell of a row: the row is current and a compact editor opens in the cell at once
type a digit, Enter: the value is committed, the editor closes, the row stays current and the footer sum updates
Down: the next row becomes current
Tab: the editor opens in the first editable cell of the row (Qty); Tab again: the next editable cell (Used)
traces.neper: set_immediate_edit(grid, true): first tap edits, commit returns the keyboard to the row (rest_row), Tab edits the next editable cell
